audience: store owners and staff who run a Shift4Shop online store and answer order and stock questions

useCases.title: Check which orders came in today and their status
useCases.text: List the orders from a date range and filter them by status. Open one order to read its customer, totals and status.

useCases.title: Trace an order through payment and shipping
useCases.text: Open an order, then read its line items, payment transactions and shipments with tracking data.

useCases.title: Answer a customer's question about their orders
useCases.text: Find the customer by email or name and read their contact and billing details. Then list the orders placed under their billing email.

useCases.title: Check stock and sale prices before a promotion
useCases.text: List the products on sale or within a stock range you set, then open one product to read its price, stock and description.

useCases.title: Review the store's categories and settings
useCases.text: List the product categories and read the general store settings, such as the store name and currency.
